title: Facts arm in query: matching active saved facts as rows inside the caller's row count and budget

baselines.note: same build, same brain writes, same query op call, key off

preregistration: README.md in this directory, pushed in garrytan/gbrain@a87c3e2af before any code or gated run

models.judge: anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5 (B2 fixed judge for ambiguous answers)
models.selection: B-suite fixed reader and judge; gbrain default embedding

gates.1: B2 corrections (gbrain-evals eval/workload-suites, corrections-v1, seed 20261006, 100 items), forget-then-remember arm key on vs off; pass if key-on corrected-value accuracy is higher at after_1_write and after_5_writes and its stale-answer rate is not higher at either; edit-sync and append lose no more than 2 points with the key on
gates.2: NamedThingBench, relational retrieval-quality, LongMemEval nightly through the query op key on vs off; recall@10 over page rows; pass if no question's recall@10 is lower with the key on
gates.3: harness lane: LongMemEval knowledge-update and PersonaMem dev slices (optional; not run)
gates.1b: B2 corrections with --remember-valid-from (remember gets each item's correction_timestamp as valid_from), same suite, seed, items, reader, judge and budget as gate 1; forget-then-remember key on vs off; pass if key-on corrected accuracy is higher at after_1_write and after_5_writes and stale not higher; edit-sync and append lose no more than 2 points with the key on
gates.2_revised: gate 2's three corpora plus the two one-saved-fact-per-question diagnostic copies; pass if no question's recall@10 is lower with the key on in any of the five

decision_rule: default-on only if gates 1 and 2 pass (and gate 3 if it runs); off until then

reproduce.gate_1: cd gbrain-evals && bun eval/workload-suites/bench.ts corrections --phase answer --arms gbrain-forget-remember --budget-usd 6 --out <dir> --gbrain <gbrain>@16288b95c [--gbrain-search-config search.query_facts_arm=true] [--remember-valid-from]; then the same command with --phase score. The two bracketed flags come from bench-flags.patch in the gbrain-evals mirror of this record, applied to gbrain-evals 00baf2b.
reproduce.gate_1b: cd gbrain-evals (d01d3bc or later) && bun eval/workload-suites/bench.ts corrections --phase answer --arms <gbrain-forget-remember | gbrain-edit-sync,gbrain-append> --remember-valid-from [--gbrain-search-config search.query_facts_arm=true] --budget-usd <cap> --out <dir> --gbrain <gbrain>@947536f4c; then --phase score

candidate_gate_1b.change: fact rows take spare capacity only (free slots under the row count, whole rows into the budget the pages leave)

baselines_gate_1b.note: same build, same correction-dated writes, key off

preregistration_gate_1b: README.md section 'Gate 1b and revised gate 2: preregistered' in garrytan/gbrain@c672352d4 (also gbrain-evals capy/mpw-gbrain-verdicts 0b2a6ae), before any gate 1b or revised gate 2 run
decision_rule_gate_1b: default-on only if gate 1b and revised gate 2 both pass
